testResults.name: hosted-health-and-bearer-auth
testResults.result: The deployed dev API returned /health status ok without credentials, rejected an unauthenticated /v1/auth/check with 401, and accepted the Key Vault-backed bearer token with 200; the check ran against the source-built image sha256:95146602 through the revision fca-ml-dev-api--0000064 composition wired by T179

testResults.name: first-query-writes-data-through-ensure
testResults.result: The hosted ensure performed a bounded, lease-protected Alpaca ingest for the missing session and returned a coverage report with state complete and 1000 rows at date=2026-08-28/asset_class=equity/data_type=trade/AAPL.parquet; both trade and quote Parquet objects for the session were created in the lake container at 2026-09-04T03:16:27Z

testResults.name: file-query-returns-complete-partition-with-sas
testResults.result: The file query returned state complete with one complete catalog partition (1000 rows, 13614 bytes) and a read-only object-scoped SAS URL

testResults.name: cached-repeat-serves-catalog-without-refetch
commands: az storage blob list before and after the cached repeat
testResults.result: The cached repeat returned the identical partition (same object path, 1000 rows, same checksum c7d90179317caac67c4887dd002a2e837f76db9e12ec819302231fa20aa9ab8b) served from the catalog, and every lake blob etag and lastModified timestamp was unchanged across the repeat, proving no refetch or rewrite

testResults.name: secure-posture-restored-after-smoke
commands: az containerapp show, az containerapp env show
testResults.result: After the smoke, the API app was restored to internal-only ingress on the internal FQDN, the managed environment public network access was returned to Disabled, and the app scale minimum was restored to zero; the temporary public exposure existed only for the duration of the smoke with all non-health routes bearer-protected

limitations: The bounded ingest intentionally caps at LAKE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS=1000 records per data type, so coverage records report partial rather than exhaustive session depth for active sessions and complete closed sessions carry the bounded row count
The public exposure was a temporary smoke posture; the documented dev posture is internal-only ingress, re-enableable via ENABLE_EXTERNAL_API_INGRESS=true plus environment public network access
